title: sanctum_login_authentication_flow
description: Test the Sanctum login endpoint with valid and invalid credentials to verify token issuance and error handling. Verify profile retrieval with valid token and error on missing token. Test logout revokes the token successfully.

title: journals_rbac_access_control
description: Verify that only master users can create and list journals via the API. Ensure balanced journals are accepted with 201, unbalanced journals rejected with 422. Confirm cashier and branch admin receive 403 on journal endpoints, and unauthenticated users receive 401.

title: consolidated_financial_reports_access
description: Test that master users can access consolidated balance sheet and income statement reports with correct data (balance sheet difference equals 0.00). Verify branch admins receive sales reports scoped to their branch only. Confirm access restrictions and data isolation for non-master roles.

title: master_data_access_authorization
description: Ensure only superadmin or master roles can list and create branches. Verify categories can be read by authenticated users but only created by authorized roles. Confirm product creation is forbidden for cashiers and allowed for authorized roles.

title: branch_isolation_product_visibility
description: Test that branch admins can only see products and stock for their own branch. Verify that querying products with other branch_id does not leak data or other_branch_stock from other divisions. Confirm barcode lookup returns 404 for products outside caller's branch.

title: checkout_and_goods_receipt_workflow
description: Validate POS checkout reduces stock and posts balanced journals. Confirm checkout rejects quantities above stock and invalid discounts with 422 and no stock change. Verify goods receipt increases stock and posts balanced inventory journals. Test discount validation on both checkout and goods receipt.
